'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] airstrikes across the [[Gaza Strip]] kill at least 26 [[Palestinians]], including four children. At least ten others are missing and believed to be buried under [[rubble]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/1/1/israel-kills-at-least-22-palestinians-across-gaza-on-new-year-day (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2025 New Orleans truck attack]]
**A man kills 14 people and injures 35 others, including two police officers, in a [[Vehicle-ramming attack|vehicle-ramming]] and [[Mass shooting|shooting attack]] on [[Bourbon Street]] in [[New Orleans]], [[Louisiana]], [[United States]], before being shot dead. The [[FBI]] says that it found an [[Islamic State]] flag in the suspect's vehicle. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/multiple-fatalities-truck-crashes-into-new-orleans-crowd-cbs-news-says-2025-01-01/ (Reuters)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**The [[African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia|African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission]], endorsed by the [[United Nations Security Council]] on December 27, replaces the [[African Union Transition Mission in Somalia|African Union Transition Mission]] as the [[African Union]]'s [[peacekeeping]] mission in [[Somalia]]. [https://von.gov.ng/un-approves-new-au-force-in-somalia/ (Voice of Nigeria)] [https://press.un.org/en/2024/sc15955.doc.htm (UN Press)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2022–2023 Russia–European Union gas dispute]]
**[[Russia]]'s gas firm [[Gazprom]] suspends exports of [[Natural gas in Russia|Russian natural gas]] through [[Natural gas transmission system of Ukraine|Ukrainian pipelines]] after [[Ukraine]] refused to renew the transit agreement between its operator [[Naftogaz]] and Gazprom. However, [[Hungary]] will continue receiving Russian [[natural gas]] via the [[TurkStream]] pipeline. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/russia-halts-gas-exports-europe-via-ukraine-2025-01-01/ (Reuters)]
*[[Foreign relations of Mexico]]
**[[Mexico]]'s [[Servicio de Administración Tributaria|Tax Administration Service]] implements new [[tariff]]s, including a 19% [[Duty (tax)|duty]] on goods from countries without international [[trade agreement]]s with Mexico and a 17% duty on goods from [[Canada]] and the [[United States]] under certain value thresholds. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexico-unveils-new-tariffs-popular-e-tailers-like-shein-temu-may-be-crosshairs-2024-12-31/ (Reuters)]
*[[Moldova–Russia relations]]
**As announced, [[Russia]]'s [[Gazprom]] halts its gas supplies both to [[Moldova]] and the self-proclaimed [[Transnistria|Transnistrian Republic]] alleging non-compliance with payment obligations. [https://www.intellinews.com/russia-cuts-gas-deliveries-to-moldova-in-attempt-to-undermine-political-stability-359712/ (bne IntelliNews)], [https://www.politico.eu/article/moldova-gas-russia-cut-off-russia-cuts-off-gas-to-moldovan-separatists-risking-humanitarian-crisis/ (Politico)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**Twenty-seven migrants from [[sub-Saharan Africa]] are killed, and 83 others are rescued after two boats capsize off the [[Kerkennah Islands]] near [[Tunisia]], with searches ongoing for additional missing passengers. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250102-27-sub-saharan-african-migrants-die-off-tunisia-in-shipwrecks (France 24)]
*Three people are killed and over twenty others are injured in a fireworks explosion at a house in [[Honolulu]], [[Hawaii]], United States. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/rescuers-find-gruesome-scene-at-a-honolulu-home-after-a-fireworks-blast-kills-3-injures-over-20-1.7162295 (CTV News)]
*A tour bus crashed into a tree in [[Surat Thani province]], [[Thailand]], killing five and 30.[https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/tour-bus-crash-in-thailands-surat-thani-leaves-5-dead-30-injured (The Straits Times)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Honduras–United States relations]]
**[[President of Honduras|Honduran President]] [[Xiomara Castro]] warns that she might remove all [[US military bases]] from [[Honduras]] and seek to cancel the military cooperation with the United States if [[President of the United States|President-elect]] [[Donald Trump]] fulfills his threat to order mass deportations of [[Honduran diaspora|Hondurans]] when he takes office next January 20. [https://ticotimes.net/2025/01/02/honduras-threatens-to-expel-u-s-military-bases-over-trumps-deportation-plans (''The Tico Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Cetinje shootings]]
**Twelve people are killed and four others are injured in a [[Spree killer|shooting spree]] in [[Cetinje]], [[Montenegro]]. The perpetrator kills himself. [https://apnews.com/article/montenegro-shooting-gunman-suicide-cetinje-7ab4ac905c4d08bca357251823dd4ee6 (AP)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/1/2/at-least-10-killed-in-mass-shooting-in-montenegro-suspect-kills-himself (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Al Jazeera controversies and criticism]]
**The [[Palestinian Authority]] suspends [[Al Jazeera Media Network|Al Jazeera]]'s broadcasts and operations in [[State of Palestine|Palestine]], accusing the network of interfering in internal affairs and spreading [[incitement]] and [[misinformation]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/palestinian-authority-suspends-broadcast-qatars-al-jazeera-tv-temporarily-2025-01-01/ (Reuters)]
*[[Capital punishment in Saudi Arabia]]
**[[Saudi Arabia]] announces the [[Capital punishment|execution]] of six [[Iran]]ian nationals convicted of [[Illegal drug trade|smuggling]] [[hashish]]. In [[Tehran]], the [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian Foreign Ministry]] summoned the Saudi ambassador in protest. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-saudi-arabia-hashish-executions-efd48a3efcdbf2664e14c8ccf879f323 (AP)]
*[[LGBTQ rights in Liechtenstein]]
**[[Liechtenstein]] becomes the 37th country to legalize [[Same-sex marriage in Liechtenstein|same-sex marriage]]. [https://gcn.ie/liechtenstein-legalise-same-sex-marriage/ (GCN)]
*[[Trump International Hotel Las Vegas Tesla Cybertruck explosion]]
**A [[Tesla Cybertruck]] containing firework mortars and gas canisters explodes outside the [[Trump International Hotel Las Vegas]] in [[Paradise, Nevada|Paradise]], [[Nevada]], [[United States]], injuring seven people. The driver died from a self-inflicted gunshot prior to the explosion. [[The Federal Bureau of Investigation]] (FBI) is currently investigating the incident as a possible terrorist attack. [https://abc7.com/post/trump-tower-fire-police-investigating-vehicle-explosion-las-vegas-nevada-hotel-driver-dead/15737979/ (ABC News)]
*Five people are killed, several others are injured, and at least 330 people are arrested due to mishandling of [[pyrotechnics]] during [[New Year's Eve|New Year's celebrations]] in [[Germany]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/world/538011/five-dead-in-germany-from-new-year-s-fireworks-accidents (RNZ)] [https://www.1news.co.nz/2025/01/02/german-government-condemns-violence-that-killed-five-on-nye/ (1News)]
*Five people are killed in a [[familicide]] [[mass stabbing]] when a son kills his four sisters and mother in [[Lucknow]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], [[India]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/uttar-pradesh/five-of-family-found-dead-in-lucknow-hotel-accused-held/article69049292.ece (''The Hindu'')]
*[[Myanmar]]'s [[Tatmadaw]] enacts a [[cybersecurity]] [[Constitution of Myanmar|law]] imposing [[Censorship in Myanmar|strict controls]] on digital communications, requiring service providers to store [[user data]] for three years, penalizing [[VPN]] use without government approval, and allowing authorities to block or shut down platforms deemed to spread disinformation or disrupt stability. [https://apnews.com/article/internet-online-censorship-law-repression-8128ba7a2c02555217c6a64ab641eaf6 (AP)]
*A [[New Zealand Police|police officer]] is killed and four other people are injured in a vehicle-ramming attack during a patrol in [[Nelson, New Zealand|Nelson]], [[New Zealand]]. A 32-year-old suspect is arrested. [https://apnews.com/article/police-officer-killed-zealand-nelson-lyn-fleming-475f2a6aa1a5e7739b19d3fd1e724733 (AP)]
*Eleven people are injured during a [[mass shooting]] outside a nightclub in [[Queens]], [[New York (state)|New York]], United States. [https://thenightly.com.au/world/new-york-nightclub-mass-shooting-11-people-reportedly-injured-after-incident-at-amazura-night-club-in-queens-c-17263836 (''The Nightly'')]
*[[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]] agents announce the seizure of more than 150 homemade [[pipe bomb]]s and other [[explosive device]]s from a home in [[Isle of Wight County, Virginia|Isle of Wight County]], [[Virginia]], [[United States]], "the largest seizure by number of finished explosive devices in FBI history". [https://apnews.com/article/homemade-bombs-seized-virginia-firearms-c68488480ef8bd3de7b432272399aa28 (AP)]
